title: An evening with SUGNL
description:
Join us on 28 October for another Sitecore User Group Netherlands evening at iO in Den Bosch!

We’ll kick things off with food, drinks and time to catch up with fellow Sitecore enthusiasts, followed by sessions on AI agents, agent-ready rendering and a hands-on workshop where you can experiment with your own headless frontend.

As always, expect an informal evening with practical knowledge, good discussions and plenty of opportunity to meet others from the Sitecore community.

activities.subject: Doors open
activities.description: Welcome to the event! Grab a drink and get ready for an evening of learning and networking.

activities.subject: Diner
activities.description: Enjoy some good food and drinks before we kick off the sessions.

activities.subject: From Next to Nitro: Sitecore’s Content SDK running on Nuxt.js
activities.description: While SitecoreAI officially champions Next.js, many enterprise frontend teams have standardized on Vue and Nuxt. In this session, we explore why and how we engineered a first-class, community-driven Nuxt 3 port of the official Content SDK. We will dive into the architectural shift from Next.js to Nitro, uncover how edge middleware and Sitecore Pages authoring were tackled, and discuss what true frontend flexibility means for the modern composable stack.

activities.subject: Your DXP was built for humans. What about AI Agents?
activities.description: AI agents do not consume websites like people do. In this session, I’ll show a Sitecore Next.js proof of concept for agent-ready rendering, including flattened components, consumer detection, and Markdown delivery from the same URL.

activities.subject: Build your own agent ready headless frontend?
activities.description: Time to put the idea into practice. In this hands-on session, you’ll adapt your own headless frontend to detect AI consumers, flatten interactive components, and experiment with agent-friendly output.

activities.subject: Drinks and snacks
activities.description: We take some time to close the evening with a few drinks.
